name: Eryndor Vale
title: The Ashen Ranger

appearance.notable_features: burn scar across left cheek, rune tattoo on right forearm

gear.armor: light leather armor reinforced with shadowsteel stitching
accessories: hunter's cloak with forest camo enchantment

personality.bond: protects the last living forest of Virelia

backstory: Once a royal scout, Eryndor was betrayed during a border war and left for dead in the Ashen Woods. He survived by bonding with forest spirits and now acts as a lone guardian of forbidden wildlands.
current_goal: hunt the corrupted sorcerer who burned his homeland
